sources.title: Water supply, wastewater and water quality
sources.facts: Explains plan-making and application considerations for water supply, wastewater infrastructure and water quality.
sources.guard: Planning guidance does not prove a specific site's network capacity, connection, permit or water-quality acceptability.

sources.title: Water resources planning guideline
sources.facts: Requires water companies to prepare and maintain water resources management plans and records the 16 June 2026 update.
sources.guard: A guideline collection does not prove a company option, supply balance or project is approved or deliverable.

sources.title: Water resources planning guideline
sources.facts: Sets the WRMP29 timetable, regulator roles, demand and supply forecasting, uncertainty and best-value planning requirements.
sources.guard: Forecast and planning requirements do not prove exact-site water availability, abstraction rights or infrastructure delivery.

sources.title: Guidelines for Statutory Drainage and Wastewater Management Plans
sources.facts: Provides guidelines for sewerage undertakers preparing, publishing and maintaining statutory DWMPs.
sources.guard: A statutory-plan framework does not prove current sewer capacity, investment, timing or connection acceptance.

sources.title: About the guidance and planning for drainage and wastewater management
sources.facts: Covers legal requirements, available capacity, current and future demand, resilience and environmental risks.
sources.guard: Plan content requirements do not establish the actual condition or capacity of a particular sewerage system.

sources.title: How to form, publish and maintain your drainage and wastewater management plan
sources.facts: Sets consultation, publication, annual review, risk assessment and preferred-plan steps, including the 2027 and 2028 publication timetable.
sources.guard: A preparation timetable does not prove consultation completion, option selection, funding or construction.

sources.title: Drainage and wastewater management plans: guiding principles for the water industry
sources.facts: Collects priorities for long-term drainage and wastewater planning, including capacity, climate and population pressures.
sources.guard: Guiding principles are not evidence of current operational performance or a site-specific drainage solution.

sources.title: Guiding principles for drainage and wastewater management plans
sources.facts: Sets government and regulator expectations for resilient, collaborative and environmentally effective drainage plans.
sources.guard: Strategic expectations do not prove a network upgrade, storm-overflow outcome, permit or development connection.
